source.source_name: Regnskapsregisteret — Register of Company Accounts (annual accounts figures)
source.attribution: Inneholder data under Norsk lisens for offentlige data (NLOD) tilgjengeliggjort av Brønnøysundregistrene.

access.note: Open API is labelled by Brreg as a temporary/research distribution. Paid Subscription Service holds full history + image copies (out of scope).

headers_required.name: Accept
headers_required.note: also supports json-ld, xml, rdf, ttl

transport.record_path: $ (top-level JSON array; one element per period x regnskapstype)

pagination.note: One request per organisation number. No open bulk file for financials.

transport.rate_limit: unknown; per-orgnr fetch — throttle; only fetch accounting-liable entities; cache by sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap

parsing.notes: Response is an ARRAY; iterate elements. Preserve source-side typos in keys: 'regnkapsprinsipper' and 'sumInnskuttEgenkaptial'. valuta varies (NOK/USD/EUR) — store currency with each figure. Empty array = no filed accounts.

mapping_rules.financial_statements: Map each array element to one yearly financial record keyed by period_end + accounts_type.
mapping_rules.prefer: Use regnskapstype=SELSKAP for the entity's own figures; KONSERN for consolidated group when present.

fixture_requirements: large filer (oppstillingsplan=store) with full income statement + balance sheet (non-NOK currency, e.g. USD)
small enterprise (regnkapsprinsipper.smaaForetak=true, fravalgRevisjon=true) with reduced figures
entity with both SELSKAP and KONSERN elements for the same year
org number with empty array (no filed accounts)
record exercising the source-side typo keys

live_test_plan.smoke: GET /regnskapsregisteret/regnskap/923609016; assert array non-empty, valuta present, sumDriftsinntekter + sumEiendeler parse as decimals.
live_test_plan.full: For the accounting-liable entity set from brregenhet (filter on sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap present), fetch per orgnr behind an env gate; throttle; persist raw JSON then normalize.
